core_benchmarks.description: Total Collatz stopping steps across [1, 5,000,000]; tests scalar arithmetic, branches, parity strength reduction, and multi-step ctz/odd reduction.
50M coupled 2-tuple state transitions; compares Lean 4 heap-boxed Prod UInt64 UInt64 against lean-native UnboxTupleSROA register tuple.
Two-pass affine transformation over 10M 64-bit array elements; compares Lean 4 per-iteration exclusivity/boxing checks against lean-native HoistExclusivity + loop fusion + SIMD/GPU.
Contiguous 10M-element 64-bit scalar dot product; tests unboxed sarray base-pointer hoisting, 4-way SIMD reduction, and GPU warp-shuffle reduction.
16.77M-element 64-bit SAXPY (Y[i] = alpha * X[i] + Y[i]); evaluates CPU LLVM SIMD vectorization and NVIDIA PTX / Hybrid GPU dispatch.
Dense 512x512 64-bit matrix multiplication (134.2M multiply-adds); compares Lean 4 nested loops against lean-native cache-tiled SIMD CPU and shared-memory tiled PTX GPU.

10M-transaction EVMYulLean 2.0 dynamic quadratic memory expansion + Keccak256 gas schedule (Gas.lean); tests branchless smax/umin, shift strength reduction (w^2 / 512 -> w^2 >> 9), 4-way SIMD vectorization, and GPU warp-shuffle reduction.

holdout_benchmarks.description: Immutable holdout verification kernel testing algebraic bitwise/shift identities and loop-carried data dependencies.
Immutable holdout verification kernel testing dual-accumulator loop bounds and shift/xor recurrence.
